id: 07_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers (Confined Space)
title: 安全知识问答：受限空间（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/07_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers (Confined Space).md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/07_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers (Confined Space)（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 通风、低压照明、通道畅通
points.K14: 潜水呼吸器不一样（了解）
points.S1: 校园里的受限空间与警示标志

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上亮着问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz desk with a glowing question-mark lamp and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天专讲受限空间。
overlay: 安全知识问答：受限空间

shots.scene: 井口、储罐、管道、地下水池四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a manhole, a storage tank, a large pipe, and an underground water tank. No people.
shots.narration: 看着普通的井和罐，可能很要命。

shots.scene: 校园路边一个打开盖子的污水井，阿杰好奇地探头
shots.prompt_en: On a campus path, the young male student leans over an open manhole and peers curiously into the dark.
shots.narration: 阿杰路过一个打开的井口。

shots.scene: 井口里飘出看不见的气体示意，阿杰的手机掉进井里
shots.prompt_en: An icon of faint invisible gas rising from a manhole and a phone falling into it. No people.
shots.narration: 手机掉了进去，他想下去捡。

shots.scene: 老李快步过来，伸手拦住阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hurries over and stretches out his arm to stop the young male student at the manhole edge.
shots.narration: 老李一把拦住：千万别下去！

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the quiz desk and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 为什么不能下？我们一题一题看。

shots.scene: 井口剖面：窄窄的入口通向下面的空间
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of a narrow manhole opening leading down into an enclosed chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是受限空间？

shots.scene: 窄入口被高亮，旁边箭头一进一出
shots.prompt_en: The narrow opening highlighted with one arrow going in and one coming out. No people.
shots.narration: 进出口受限，部分或全部封闭。

shots.scene: 空间里放着一张被打叉的床和椅子图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the enclosed chamber icon, a bed and a chair icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是给人长时间待的地方。

shots.scene: 空间内氧气图标忽多忽少，旁边火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the chamber icon, an oxygen symbol shrinking and growing, and a flame icon near a vapor cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 可能缺氧、富氧，或积聚可燃气。

shots.scene: 受限空间剖面图，八个危害图标浮现
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of an enclosed tank with eight hazard icons appearing one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：里面有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 骷髅和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A skull pictogram and a flame pictogram inside the tank icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒气体和可燃气体。

shots.scene: 爆炸和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: An explosion burst icon inside the tank with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体一遇火，就会着火爆炸。

shots.scene: 停滞的空气和黑暗的空间
shots.prompt_en: The tank icon with still air lines and a dark interior with a dim lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 通风不良，照明不足。

shots.scene: 氧气图标一个变小一个变大
shots.prompt_en: Two oxygen icons, one shrinking with a down arrow and one swelling with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气太少会窒息，太多易起火。

shots.scene: 窄梯子和温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A narrow ladder icon and a thermometer icon with both hot and cold ends glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 进出不便，温度可能极高或极低。

shots.scene: 欣欣摊开双手，身后的危害图标越来越多
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its hands as more hazard icons pile up behind it.
shots.narration: 里面干的活越多，危害也越多。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白许可单上签字，交给外包队负责人老李
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank entry permit and hands it to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 第三题：进入前要做什么？先办许可。

shots.scene: 老李和保卫处值班员拿着空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the security officer each hold a blank training certificate.
shots.narration: 进去的每个人，都要受过培训。

shots.scene: 老李把检测仪探头伸进井口，值班员在旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lowers a gas detector probe on a hose into a manhole while the security officer watches.
shots.narration: 开工前，由有资格的人测气。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕空白，旁边三个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector with a blank screen and three icons beside it, oxygen, flame, skull, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气、可燃气、有毒气都要测。

shots.scene: 老李守在井口，手拿空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands at the manhole edge holding a blank entry and exit log sheet.
shots.narration: 井口安排监护人，登记进出。

shots.scene: 老李对着井下喊话，井下传来回应
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer leans toward the manhole and calls down, a speech bubble icon coming back up.
shots.narration: 和井下人员时刻保持联络。

shots.section_title: 通风、低压照明、通道畅通
shots.scene: 风机向井口送风
shots.prompt_en: A portable ventilation fan with a duct blowing fresh air down into a manhole. No people.
shots.narration: 要有良好的通风。
overlay: 通风、低压照明、通道畅通

shots.section_title: 通风、低压照明、通道畅通
shots.scene: 低压安全灯和普通插电灯，后者打叉
shots.prompt_en: A safety lamp icon with a low-voltage symbol next to an ordinary mains lamp crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 照明用安全电压灯具，防触电和火花。

shots.section_title: 通风、低压照明、通道畅通
shots.scene: 稳固的梯子和畅通的通道
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy fixed ladder leading out of a manhole with a clear path around it. No people.
shots.narration: 进出通道要畅通。

shots.scene: 空白救援预案贴在现场，老李给值班员讲解
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer explains a blank rescue plan board to the security officer beside a manhole.
shots.narration: 人人熟悉应急救援预案。

shots.scene: 担架、安全带、三脚架、呼吸器、急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a stretcher, a full-body harness, a rescue tripod, a breathing apparatus, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 救援装备，提前备在现场。

shots.scene: 监护人用三脚架绳索在井外拉人
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer operates a tripod winch at the manhole opening, pulling up a lifeline, without entering.
shots.narration: 出事先在井外拉，监护人不下井。

shots.scene: 老李戴着监护人袖标站在井口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a blank armband and stands alert at the manhole with a whistle and a radio.
shots.narration: 第四题：监护人是什么人？

shots.scene: 危害图标和应急按钮图标出现在老李身旁
shots.prompt_en: Hazard icons and an emergency alarm button icon appear next to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 懂得危害，出事知道怎么应对。

shots.scene: 老李在空白登记表上记下进出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes on a blank log sheet beside the manhole, a ladder leading down into it.
shots.narration: 他还要记好每个人的进出。

shots.scene: 管道、容器、储罐、筒仓、风管、深沟六个图标
shots.prompt_en: Six icons: a pipe, a pressure vessel, a storage tank, a silo, an air duct, and a deep trench. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：哪些属于受限空间？

shots.scene: 校园里的污水井、地下水池、管道井图标
shots.prompt_en: Campus icons: a sewer manhole, an underground water tank, and a utility shaft. No people.
shots.narration: 校园里也有：污水井、水池、管井。

shots.scene: 焊接、切割、打磨三个图标，火花四溅
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with sparks: a welding torch, a cutting disc, and a grinder. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：什么是动火作业？

shots.scene: 火花旁出现火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Sparks from a grinder icon landing near a flame icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 会产生火源的作业，都算动火。

shots.scene: 空白审批单和灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank approval form next to a fire extinguisher icon and a watch person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 动火要审批，有人看火、备灭火器。

shots.scene: 骷髅和腐蚀象形图并排，旁边一个鸡蛋图标
shots.prompt_en: A skull pictogram and a corrosion pictogram side by side next to a cracked egg icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：硫化氢有多危险？

shots.scene: 气体云中倒下的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram collapsing inside a faint gas cloud with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒又有腐蚀性，很低浓度就伤人。

shots.scene: 污水井图标上方飘着气体
shots.prompt_en: A sewer manhole icon with faint gas rising from it. No people.
shots.narration: 污水井、化粪池里，常有它。

shots.scene: 过滤式面具和长管供气面罩两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a half-face respirator with filter cartridges and a full-face mask connected by a hose to an air source. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：呼吸器分哪两类？

shots.scene: 过滤式面具把周围空气过滤后吸入
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show surrounding air passing through a cartridge into a respirator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤式：把周围空气滤干净再吸。

shots.scene: 供气式面罩由软管接气源
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show clean air flowing from a cylinder through a hose into a full-face mask icon. No people.
shots.narration: 供气式：由独立气源送来干净空气。

shots.scene: 缺氧空间里的过滤式面具，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A filter respirator icon inside a low-oxygen tank icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧的地方，过滤式不管用。

shots.scene: 背着气瓶、戴全面罩的救援人员图标
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a rescuer wearing a full-face mask with an air cylinder on the back. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：自给式空气呼吸器。

shots.scene: 消防员和救援队的图标
shots.prompt_en: Pictograms of a firefighter and a confined space rescue team member, both with breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 自己背气瓶，消防和救援队常用。

shots.section_title: 潜水呼吸器不一样（了解）
shots.scene: 水下潜水员图标和陆地救援人员图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons compared: an underwater diver with a tank and a land rescuer with a breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：潜水呼吸器，了解即可。
overlay: 潜水呼吸器不一样（了解）

shots.section_title: 潜水呼吸器不一样（了解）
shots.scene: 两个图标之间一个不等号
shots.prompt_en: The diver icon and the land rescuer icon with a not-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 一个用在水下，一个用在水面以上。

shots.section_title: 潜水呼吸器不一样（了解）
shots.scene: 两种呼吸器混放被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the two kinds of breathing apparatus swapped, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用途不同，不能混用。

shots.scene: 气瓶图标和压力表图标
shots.prompt_en: An air cylinder icon next to a pressure gauge icon with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一题：呼吸器能用多久？

shots.scene: 气瓶里是压缩的普通空气
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway cylinder icon filled with ordinary air dots, compressed tightly. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶里装的是压缩的普通空气。

shots.scene: 每分钟耗气量乘以分钟数的图示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lung with a small air cloud per minute, multiplied by a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每分钟耗多少，乘以要用的时间。

shots.scene: 压力表指针下降，旁边一个跑动的小人
shots.prompt_en: The pressure gauge needle drops while a person pictogram runs, showing faster consumption. No people.
shots.narration: 干活越累，耗气越快。

shots.scene: 压力表上留出一段余量，余压报警哨响
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge with a reserved zone near the bottom and a whistle icon sounding. No people.
shots.narration: 留足撤离余量，报警一响就撤。

shots.section_title: 校园里的受限空间与警示标志
shots.scene: 老李和王老师在校园地图上圈出几处井口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator circle several spots on a blank campus map.
shots.narration: 先摸清：校园哪些地方是受限空间。
overlay: 校园里的受限空间与警示标志

shots.section_title: 校园里的受限空间与警示标志
shots.scene: 井盖旁立着警示牌，井盖上锁
shots.prompt_en: A locked manhole cover with a confined space warning sign standing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 设警示标志，井盖盖好、锁好。

shots.section_title: 校园里的受限空间与警示标志
shots.scene: 打开的井口四周有围栏和警示牌
shots.prompt_en: An open manhole surrounded by a temporary barrier and a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 作业时围挡，防止路人掉落、误入。

shots.scene: 三个图标用箭头连成一串：风机、检测仪、人员进入
shots.prompt_en: Three icons connected by arrows: a ventilation fan, a gas detector, and a worker entering a manhole. No people.
shots.narration: 顺序不能乱：先通风，再检测，后作业。

shots.scene: 老李胸前挂着便携检测仪在井下作业
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works inside an underground chamber with a portable gas detector clipped to his chest and a fan duct nearby.
shots.narration: 作业中持续检测，不是测一次就完。

shots.scene: 检测仪报警，老李沿梯子撤出
shots.prompt_en: The portable detector flashes red as the facility engineer quickly climbs out up the ladder.
shots.narration: 一报警，立刻撤出。

shots.scene: 停顿后再次检测的时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a looping arrow back to the gas detector icon. No people.
shots.narration: 中断后再进，要重新检测。

shots.scene: 阿杰捡手机的念头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student climbing into a manhole to reach a phone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生和实验室人员，不擅自进入。

shots.scene: 老李打电话联系后勤和外包单位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer makes a phone call next to the barrier around the manhole.
shots.narration: 东西掉了，找后勤，交给专业队伍。

shots.scene: 老李出示作业单位的空白资质证书，王老师核对
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows a blank qualification certificate to the safety administrator, who checks it.
shots.narration: 作业单位要有资质，学校审批监管。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老李点头致谢
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and thanks the facility engineer beside the barrier.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：手机没命重要。

shots.scene: 老李检查呼吸器气瓶压力表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the pressure gauge on a breathing apparatus cylinder.
shots.narration: 空气呼吸器，用前先查压力。

shots.scene: 检查报警哨、面罩、背带三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each with a green check: a warning whistle, a full-face mask, and harness straps. No people.
shots.narration: 查报警哨，查面罩，查背带。

shots.scene: 老李戴上面罩，双手捂住进气口检查密合
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on the full-face mask and covers the inlet with both hands to check the seal.
shots.narration: 戴上后检查密合，不漏气。

shots.scene: 王老师给老李和值班员上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches the facility engineer and the security officer in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 会用才敢用，定期培训和演练。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现井口和危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a manhole icon surrounded by hazard icons.
shots.narration: 受限空间：缺氧、毒气、着火爆炸。

shots.scene: 许可单、培训证书、检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank permit, a blank training certificate, and a gas detector. No people.
shots.narration: 先审批、先培训，通风检测再进入。

shots.scene: 监护人、风机、安全灯、梯子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a guard pictogram with a log sheet, a ventilation fan, a safety lamp, and a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 有人监护，通风照明通道都要好。

shots.scene: 三脚架和呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rescue tripod and a breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 备好装备，绝不盲目下井。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye from behind the quiz desk with the question-mark lamp.
shots.narration: 井口不探头，下期再见！
